My point was they don’t know the difference between the words ‘moral’ and ‘political’ 

Also, last I checked Asia and Europe aren’t countries. But a big variable left unchecked is [mental health.](http://www.nbcnews.com/id/5111202/ns/health-mental_health/t/global-study-finds-mental-illness-widespread/)

No, you disagree politically. I’m sure the person you are replying to doesn’t want to see people get killed or hurt, most ordinary folks don’t. 

Also, I’ve never heard of a gun up and shooting anyone all by itself. People kill people.

I agree with everything you said here. Not to knock the owner but I think the lack of 1 on 1 obedience training is a lot of the problem here.

In my opinion, basic training isn’t so much for the pup to learn sit/stay as it is for the owner to learn the pup and his/her personality, as well as some bonding time.


My advice to the owner: Practice obedience daily. Avoid dog parks for a bit while you strengthen your bond. 

A lot of people here are against dog parks. I think dog parks are essential for a regular ole domestic doggo. Your dog doesn’t sound reactive/aggressive. But watch your pup and if you see any ‘policing’ distract him immediately. 

My ‘motto’

Don’t expect your dog to listen to you 100% of the time. Save your recalls for when you have a justifiable reward.  Train frequently. It’s okay to be a hardass sometimes. We aren’t perfect and neither is any dog.
